title: Administrative benefits and automated burden stress test
governing_question: Can APC-01 prevent or repair an administrative system that converts a statistical budget, income inference, non-response, or transformed data into service reduction or debt before the affected person can inspect and contest the basis?

systems.jurisdiction: United States — Idaho and Ninth Circuit
systems.represented_population: Medicaid developmental-disability waiver participants and guardians
systems.institutional_action: Statistical budget calculation constrained individualized service plans and produced reductions.
systems.observed_control: Class litigation produced individualized-notice duties, evidence access, a service-preserving injunction, restored prior budgets, human assistance before reduction, and an ordered replacement process.
systems.largest_limit: The protection was litigation-intensive and did not establish ordinary automatic pause, beneficiary co-governance, completed durable substitution, compensation, or value recovery.

systems.represented_population: Income-support recipients selected for income matching, debt calculation, collection, dispute, and redress
systems.institutional_action: Population selection, identity matching, annual-income transformation, averaging, non-response rules, calculation, notice, and collection were used to raise and pursue debts.
systems.observed_control: Disputes, litigation, compulsory inquiry, public reconstruction, debt reversal, reform, settlement, and compensation mechanisms arrived after widespread action and harm.
systems.largest_limit: The principal protection was retrospective; the record does not show an ordinary pre-debt action packet, automatic stay, affected-party co-governance, durable successor control, or R7 distribution.

domain_adapter.name: Benefits and Debt Covenant
domain_adapter.purpose: Apply APC-01 to public-benefit reduction and administrative-debt action without converting eligibility administration into a self-authorizing inference system.
covered_actions: collection, garnishment, offset, referral, or penalty
mandatory information demand whose non-response creates an adverse inference
replacement of an existing individualized plan with a model-generated cap
administrative_invariants: The institution bears the burden to prove a reduction or debt before material collection or service loss.
Silence, non-response, missing historical records, or inability to reconstruct old income does not establish the institution's claim by itself.
A notice must expose the exact inputs, transformations, rule, version, threshold, legal basis, user action, calculation, and method for independent reproduction.
A timely material contest automatically preserves the pre-action service, benefit, or non-collection status quo unless an independent authority approves a bounded emergency exception.
The represented person receives qualified assistance where disability, language, age, digital access, legal complexity, or institutional design creates a practical access barrier.
Correction propagates through every downstream debt, service plan, score, referral, collection system, and external recipient.
A replacement model cannot terminate judicial or constitutional protection until transparent validation and observed participant outcomes satisfy the approval standard.
Administrative efficiency, budget pressure, batch volume, non-response, and fraud-prevention generalities are not emergency exceptions.
Compensation and value recovery remain separate: repayment or refund restores money wrongly taken, while R7 addresses value, learning, capacity, and risk allocation created through the scheme.

r_level_tests.required_by_apc: Usable notice before avoidable reduction or debt, naming the system, action, authority, inputs, calculation, consequence, evidence route, and pause right.
r_level_tests.kw_observation: Courts required adequate individualized notice before reductions, but the protection followed litigation rather than ordinary system design.
r_level_tests.robodebt_observation: Notifications existed, but affected people carried substantial dispute burdens and the record does not show a notice that made the transformed income and debt claim independently reproducible before collection.
missing: proof that notice started a real contestation window before action

r_level_tests.required_by_apc: Material evidence inspection, independent reproduction, correction, annotation, quarantine, deletion where warranted, and downstream propagation.
r_level_tests.kw_observation: Litigation exposed variables, coefficients, discarded records, notice defects, and model inadequacy; ordinary participant access before reduction remained incomplete.
r_level_tests.robodebt_observation: A large public archive reconstructed process and rules after action; person-level pre-debt access and downstream correction require further acquisition.
missing: model or rule versions available before action

r_level_tests.required_by_apc: Automatic pause and institutional proof burden before service loss, collection, penalty, or irreversible action.
r_level_tests.kw_observation: Prior budgets were restored and reductions were blocked without adequate notice, creating an operated service-preserving counterfactual and shifting the burden to the state.
r_level_tests.robodebt_observation: Systemic review and redress followed years of debt action; the current record does not show an automatic stay for a timely material dispute across the scheme.
missing: effect on legitimate recovery and administrative delay

r_level_tests.required_by_apc: Binding reversal, restoration, debt cancellation, deletion, compensation, systemic correction, and residual-injury review.
r_level_tests.kw_observation: Prior budgets and process protections were restored; completed replacement performance, compensation, health outcomes, and residual injury remain open.
r_level_tests.robodebt_observation: Debt reversal, public findings, reform, settlement, and compensation mechanisms exist, but timing, completeness, person-level payment, deletion, and residual injury require continued reconciliation.

r_level_tests.required_by_apc: Durable substitution and public operating capacity with validated data, rule, staff, service, responsibility, performance, and accountability continuity.
r_level_tests.kw_observation: A new tool was required and prior benefits continued, but selection, validation, migration, final operation, outcomes, and residual dependencies remain unresolved.
r_level_tests.robodebt_observation: The unlawful scheme ended and government adopted reforms, but the complete successor automated-decision architecture and recurrence risk remain open.

r_level_tests.required_by_apc: Affected-party representatives can bind purpose, category, threshold, acceptable use, exception, approval, redesign, or termination.
r_level_tests.kw_observation: Class plaintiffs and court-mandated assistance created voice and process, not standing beneficiary co-governance over model design and use.
r_level_tests.robodebt_observation: Affected people supplied submissions and testimony to retrospective review; the source set does not show a binding recipient body before or during scheme operation.

r_level_tests.required_by_apc: Public and affected parties recover value proportionate to authority, data, labor, risk, error, injury, operational learning, and institutional capacity supplied.
r_level_tests.kw_observation: Service preservation and redesign do not establish compensation or value rights for participants whose lives and litigation exposed the defects.
r_level_tests.robodebt_observation: Refund, settlement, and compensation can remedy loss but do not by themselves establish residual rights in institutional learning, administrative capacity, data, or future savings.

fields: benefit or service program and exact legal authority
represented person, guardian, household, or bounded class
source data, dates, provenance, missingness, and correction history
assessment, matching, averaging, imputation, coefficient, variable, and rule
model, spreadsheet, policy, software, and notice version

action_packet_translation.burden_rule: The public institution must establish the complete action packet and lawful debt or reduction before collection or avoidable service loss. A person is not required to disprove a claim whose material institutional records are missing, inaccessible, transformed without disclosure, or held by the institution.
action_packet_translation.non_response_rule: Non-response may trigger assistance, investigation, or a bounded request for records; it may not by itself establish income, debt, ineligibility, fraud, or waiver of the pause.
action_packet_translation.emergency_rule: Only a specific imminent safety or service-integrity risk may justify temporary action without ordinary timing. Budget pressure, caseload, fraud rhetoric, administrative convenience, and performance targets do not qualify.

cross_system_controls.claim: K.W. demonstrates that a court can preserve the status quo and shift the burden before continued service reduction.
cross_system_controls.limit: The control required class litigation and does not show ordinary automatic operation.

cross_system_controls.claim: Robodebt demonstrates that compulsory evidence reconstruction and financial redress can arrive after a large-scale automated burden has operated.
cross_system_controls.limit: Retrospective reconstruction and compensation do not supply timely prevention or complete R7.

cross_system_controls.claim: K.W. and Robodebt can be combined as proof that APC-01 works in administrative benefits.
cross_system_controls.limit: The controls occurred in separate systems, jurisdictions, time periods, legal vehicles, and institutional contexts.

cross_system_controls.claim: Administrative systems require the institution to prove reduction or debt before action rather than treating the person's inability to disprove transformed records as evidence.
cross_system_controls.limit: Operational cost, legitimate error prevention, emergency conditions, and false-negative risks require observed testing.

cross_system_controls.claim: Compensation for wrongful loss is R4 remedy and cannot be counted as R7 value recovery without an additional contribution-right-realization-distribution chain.
cross_system_controls.limit: A compensation instrument could also contain R7 elements, but they must be separately identified.

kw: deidentified participant action packets before and after judicial intervention
notices, variables, coefficients, source records, versions, user actions, and independent reproduction

service continuity, health, quality-of-life, provider-capacity, and cost outcomes
replacement-tool selection, validation, migration, operation, and successor governance

comparators: benefit or debt systems with automatic pre-action stays
systems using ordinary verification rather than averaging or imputation
jurisdictions with beneficiary or claimant co-governance
programs with compensation funds, data trusts, public ownership, or value-sharing
non-automated and human-assisted workflows with measured accuracy, delay, cost, and access

propositions.claim: K.W. supplies a bounded positive control for APC-01 R3 because judicial relief preserved services and shifted the burden before continued reduction.
propositions.falsifier: The injunction did not preserve services, did not alter the burden, or produced equivalent or worse harm.
propositions.stopping_rule: Keep ordinary automatic operation separate from court-ordered relief.

propositions.claim: Robodebt supplies a bounded negative control for APC-01 pre-action design and a positive control for retrospective R2/R4 reconstruction and redress.
propositions.falsifier: Representative records show effective ordinary pre-debt notice, access, pause, and institutional proof before collection.
propositions.stopping_rule: Do not convert late redress into timely prevention.

propositions.claim: The institution should bear the complete proof burden before a service reduction or debt based on transformed data, model output, or non-response.
propositions.falsifier: Observed testing shows the rule creates unacceptable harm, delay, fraud exposure, or administrative failure without materially improving justice and accuracy.
propositions.stopping_rule: Require matched operational and affected-person outcomes, not doctrinal appeal alone.

propositions.claim: K.W. and Robodebt together prove that APC-01 works in administrative benefits.
propositions.falsifier: One bounded administrative deployment demonstrates the full R1-R7 stack with durability and anti-bypass controls.
propositions.stopping_rule: Do not stack controls across systems by analogy.

propositions.claim: Refunds, settlements, and compensation in Robodebt establish R7 value recovery.
propositions.falsifier: An operative instrument joins recipient contribution or injury to residual rights, realized value, and affected-party distribution beyond restoration of loss.
propositions.stopping_rule: Keep remedy and value recovery separately accounted.

propositions.claim: APC-ADMIN-01 is ready for observed implementation testing in a current administrative program.
propositions.falsifier: The action packet, pause, burden, correction, remedy, exit, governance, or value rules are internally incompatible or legally impossible in the selected pilot.
propositions.stopping_rule: Select one current deployment and freeze legal authority, workflow, population, timing, records, costs, safeguards, and outcome metrics before piloting.

current_result.kw_positive_control: R3/R4 litigation-enabled service preservation and burden shift
current_result.robodebt_negative_control: pre-action APC protections not observed at scheme scale
current_result.robodebt_positive_control: retrospective evidence reconstruction, reversal, reform, settlement, and compensation
current_result.highest_supported_domain_result: candidate administrative burden-inversion design supported for pilot specification
current_result.next_step: Acquire one current administrative deployment suitable for a frozen APC-ADMIN-01 pilot and complete the K.W. and Robodebt outcome denominators.
